answer: Agents buying signal surveys of a grove on karst terrain can settle auctions through an attested enclave. Buyers encrypt bids only to an enclave key whose hardware attestation binds it to audited auction code. That code selects the winner from committed bids and signs the result; settlement rejects results from other keys. A swarm of auctioneer aliases cannot replace the rule with a fabricated majority verdict. This resists sybil result forgery, assuming secure attestation hardware and code; bid manipulation remains possible.
